snippet.title: HMUR - Yoba Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR
VK Play - https://vkplay.ru/play/game/hmur/
Xbox Store - https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n9r6k7ttdgt
PS Store - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015343

HMUR is a high-speed retro first-person shooter that combines the hardcore action of Hotline Miami, the high-tech Soviet setting of Atomic Heart, and Dusk's intense gunplay. Every move is your chance to survive, every stop is a ticket to oblivion.

HMUR Discord - https://discord.com/invite/6xGjEc4kFc

#atomicheart #hotlinemiami #retroshooter
